# FootBattle

FootBattle (PlayFootBattle, playfootbattle.com) is an independent football games, trivia and football information platform available in Turkish and English.

Canonical site: https://playfootbattle.com
Turkish home: https://playfootbattle.com/tr
English home: https://playfootbattle.com/en

## Football competition hubs
FootBattle provides 2026/27 standings, fixtures, results, team pages and score predictions for major football competitions.

- Turkish Süper Lig: https://playfootbattle.com/tr/super-lig
- Premier League: https://playfootbattle.com/tr/premier-league
- La Liga: https://playfootbattle.com/tr/la-liga
- Serie A: https://playfootbattle.com/tr/serie-a
- Bundesliga: https://playfootbattle.com/tr/bundesliga
- Ligue 1: https://playfootbattle.com/tr/ligue-1
- Primeira Liga: https://playfootbattle.com/tr/primeira-liga
- UEFA Champions League: https://playfootbattle.com/tr/champions-league
- UEFA Europa League: https://playfootbattle.com/tr/europa-league
- UEFA Conference League: https://playfootbattle.com/tr/conference-league
- All competitions: https://playfootbattle.com/tr/competitions

English equivalents use /en/ instead of /tr/.

## Match predictions
Signed-in users can predict exact football scores before kickoff. Predictions can be edited until kickoff. A correct match outcome awards 20 XP; an exact score awards 100 XP. Exact-score rewards replace, rather than stack with, the correct-outcome reward.

## Football games
FootBattle includes browser-based football trivia and guessing games such as Guess the Player, Football Wordle, Career Path, Tic Tac Toe, transfer quizzes, daily challenges and competitive modes.

Games directory: https://playfootbattle.com/tr/games
English games directory: https://playfootbattle.com/en/games

## Football tools
FootBattle also provides football-related utilities including amateur match and squad tools.

## Content and identity
- Brand name: FootBattle
- Alternate names: PlayFootBattle, Play FootBattle
- Main topic: association football / soccer
- Languages: Turkish and English
- Access: browser-based; core public pages are free to access
